question: Is a window served from the day library exactly what recomputing it produces? If not, reuse could silently change a result.

case.why: a full week carries BOTH day-type pools, so the mixed weekday/weekend composition is exercised, not just weekdays

method: same window built twice against identical inputs: cold with runs/demand-days emptied first, then warm with every day served from the library. All six published artifacts and the metadata fit sections byte-compared.

cold.library: demand day library: 0/7 day(s) reused, 7 calibrated

warm.library: demand day library: 7/7 day(s) reused, 0 calibrated

note: The unit-scale version of this equality (assembly vs monolithic writer on a 2-day fixture) is a permanent regression test in tests/test_day_library.py::TestAssemblyEqualsMonolith. This record is the full-scale run the plan asked for.
